ATS uses audit() and normalise() as advisory writing rules. It does not invoke
cleanse.sh, launch another agent, send text externally, or apply edits automatically.
Numbers near people/project nouns are evidence-review prompts, never penalties.
Technical vocabulary and ordinary skills lists receive context-sensitive filtering.
